newsitem.title: USA: Cypress Holding to acquire mutual fund contracts.
newsitem.headline: Cypress Holding to acquire mutual fund contracts.

text.p: Cypress Holding Co said Tuesday its mutual funds affiliate will acquire the advisory and distribution contracts for the North American Funds from North American Security Life Insurance Co.
The affiliate, CypressTree Investments Inc, will complete the purchase subject to board, shareholder and regulatory approval, the company said. Terms were not disclosed.
The North American Funds has more than $800 million under contract.
Cypress is owned privately by Boston companies Berkshire Partners LLC and Standish, Ayer & Wood Inc.
